snippet.title: Spinera - Official Demo Trailer
snippet.description: Take a look at gameplay from Spinera in this trailer for this upcoming roguelike civilization-management deckbuilder game, where every turn starts with a spin. Resources are generated through a slot-machine-inspired system, then used to expand your civilization through the ages. Discover technologies, recruit great minds, construct wonders, and build powerful combos to survive the passage of time. Spinera will be available on PC, and a demo is out now on Steam.
